recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-18349 unless a future work group decision changes the general modifierExtension processing guidance.
issue_request: FHIR-18349 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-I clarification asking to change the modifierExtension warning from "an application cannot safely process the resource" to "an application is restricted in its ability to safely process the resource" because some processing remains possible even when modifier extensions are unknown.
initial_application: Commit 1298182097c3c6d8dbbe2f929b1ed30ab3bf00c6 changed source/extensibility.html to the softened wording, and the Jira snapshot's GH#1298182097 comment matches that implementation commit.
additional_context: source/extensibility.html is active current build surface, with source/fhir.ini mapping extension=extensibility and source/navigation.xml also linking the Extensibility page. Exact source searches found no remaining occurrence of the old full sentence. Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no directly relevant later decision that would alter the FHIR-18349 conclusion.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because the current source already implements the requested clarification and additional rewording would be unnecessary editorial drift.
